scenes.line1: How do you launch many containers?
scenes.say: How do you launch multiple containers, like a web app and its database, with just one command?

scenes.label: YAML
scenes.sub: Define all services in one docker-compose.yml file.
scenes.say: Docker Compose lets you define all your services in one YAML file. It's clear and easy to edit.
Write your compose file, run 'up' to start all containers, check logs for each service, and bring everything down when done.

scenes.title: Start, log, stop
scenes.say: The main commands are: up to start, logs to watch output, and down to stop and clean up.

scenes.question: Can Compose run across many hosts?
scenes.right: No, Compose is single-host only. For multi-host, use Kubernetes.
scenes.say: Here's a trap: Can Compose run across many hosts? No, Compose is single-host only. For multi-host setups, you need Kubernetes.
